# Curtly

> Curtly is a hosted LLM prompt compression API and OpenAI-compatible proxy that reduces input and output token usage. It protects code, JSON, SQL, URLs and template variables with a "Safe Vault" before compressing, and adds an Output Brevity Governor for shorter model answers. This repository is documentation only; the service is closed source.
